accept.summary: Accepted file types as a list of MIME types, wildcards and extensions (`['image/*', '.pdf']`); the chooser offers only these and other files are rejected with a message.

actions.summary: Slot for action controls (buttons, links, menus) shown in the component's header or row.
actions.variance: `ReactNode` control slot on Banner, Card, CollapsibleCard, TabList, CopyField, Header. RuleBuilder, RuleList use `readonly RuleAction[]`: data definitions of the actions a rule can run, not rendered controls.

allowsHost.summary: Accepts a bare IP address and converts it to a /32 or /128 prefix. Defaults to true.

aria-describedby.summary: Id(s) of the element(s) that describe the component, passed to the accessible element.

aria-label.summary: Accessible name for the component (or its trigger/landmark) when there is no visible label; many default to a localized message.

aria-labelledby.summary: Id(s) of the element(s) that label the component.

as.summary: The HTML element the component renders as.
as.variance: `LayoutElement` (default `div`) on Grid, Inline, Stack; `'p' or 'span' or 'div'` (default `p`) on Text.

asks.summary: Ask-side order book levels, in any order.

background.summary: Background colour of the rendered code image (light modules, spaces and quiet zone). Defaults to white.

basePath.summary: URL path flag SVGs are served from (`<basePath>/<code>.svg`); per-component values override FlagProvider's. Defaults to `/images/flags`.

bids.summary: Bid-side order book levels, in any order.

body.summary: Dialog body content; UnsavedChangesDialog defaults to its `unsavedChangesBody` message.

categories.variance: `readonly string[]` axis labels on CategoryBarChart, CategoryChart, CategoryRadar, BoxPlotChart; `readonly StatusCategory[]` (id, label, icon, severity, alerts objects) on StatusBar.

cellSize.summary: Heatmap cell sizing: `fit` shrinks cells (min 10 px, 24 px on touch) to fit width; `sm`, `md`, `lg` are fixed sizes.

children.summary: The component's content (label, body, items or panes, as fitting the component).
children.variance: Mostly `ReactNode`. Function-or-node: TabList, Select, ComboBox (`(item) => ...`); MultiSelect render function only; Dialog, Drawer `DialogContent` (function receives `close`); ContextMenuTrigger `[target, Menu]` tuple; Markdown `string` source.

className.summary: Extra CSS classes for the component's outer element; later classes override the component's own.

classNames.summary: Extra CSS classes keyed by inner part of the component.
classNames.variance: Object keys differ per component: Dialog `{ body, footer }`; Card `{ header, body, footer }`; Disclosure `{ trigger, panel }`; AppShell `{ main }`.

color.summary: Palette colour (`chart-1` to `chart-10` or a tone) for the component's primary fill; charts default to `chart-1`.

columns.summary: Layout column count, fixed or responsive by container width.
columns.variance: Layout count (`Columns or GridColumns`, or `1 or 2 or 3`) on Grid, MultiView, DescriptionList; slides per view on Carousel (Grid's type). Data column definitions on DataTable, TableToolbar, EditableTable, Spreadsheet. Axis items on HeatmapChart. Column timestamps on Flowsheet.

config.summary: The configuration object that drives the form or field renderer.
config.variance: `FormConfig<V, TCustom>` (whole form) on ConfigForm, DialogForm, CardForm, PageForm, WizardForm; generic `TConfig` (a single field's config) on FieldRenderer.

createId.summary: Generates ids for newly added items. Defaults to ids unique within the component or page.

crossOrigin.summary: CORS mode (`anonymous` or `use-credentials`) for the underlying media element.

currency.summary: ISO 4217 currency code used to format or label monetary values.

currentPath.summary: Current location from the app's router; the best-matching nav item is marked current.

currentStep.summary: Zero-based index of the active step (wizard and dialog progress, or a sequencer playhead).

data.summary: The data series or tree the visualization plots.
data.variance: `readonly number[]` on Sparkline; `readonly Ohlc[]` on CandlestickChart; root `TreemapNode` on Treemap.

defaultExpandedIds.summary: Ids of items expanded initially, uncontrolled (any iterable of ids).
defaultExpandedIds.variance: `Iterable<string>` on GanttChart, KanbanBoard, LogViewer, OrgChart, PlanReview, Tree; `ReadonlySet<string>` on DataTable (tree rows).

defaultOpen.summary: Whether the component starts open, uncontrolled. Usually defaults to false; Banner defaults to true.

defaultUnit.summary: Unit selected while the unit field is empty.
defaultUnit.variance: Component-specific unit unions: `BitrateUnit` (default Mbps) on BitrateField; `ByteUnit` (default MiB) on ByteSizeField; `DurationUnit` (default smallest offered) on DurationField.

defaultValue.summary: Initial value, uncontrolled; each component uses its own value type.
defaultValue.variance: Varies per component's value: e.g. `number or null` on NumberField and unit fields (base unit); `string` on text editors; `NoInfer<K>` ids on Select, MultiSelect; date types on calendars and pickers; `Rule` on RuleBuilder; `MediaAsset or null` on AssetPicker.

defaultVelocity.summary: MIDI velocity for newly added notes or steps. Defaults to 100.

density.summary: Visual density of rows or tiles.
density.variance: `'compact' or 'regular'` (default `regular`) on DataTable, Spreadsheet, ListView, TransferList; `'compact' or 'card'` (default `card`) on TileGrid.

depth.summary: Number of price levels per side shown or used. OrderBook defaults to 10; DepthChart to all.

description.summary: Secondary or help text shown under the title, label or input.

details.summary: Technical details (error code, request id, server message) shown in a collapsed Details disclosure.
details.variance: ErrorState: `ReactNode` technical details content. Flag: `readonly FlagDetail[]` selecting which facts (name, nativeName, code, languages) to show beside the flag.

direction.variance: Timer: `'down' or 'up'` counting direction (default down). Stack: `'column' or 'row'` layout axis (default column).

display.variance: DurationField: `'compound' or 'single'` formatting of the committed value as one or several units. MathFormula: `'inline' or 'block'` layout placement in text vs centred block.

duration.summary: Media duration in seconds; `Infinity` or `NaN` when unknown on MediaTransport.

editMode.summary: `cell` edits one cell on Enter, F2 or double-click; `always` shows every editor. EditableTable defaults to `cell`, LineItemsEditor to `always`.

elapsedMs.summary: Elapsed time so far in milliseconds, supplied by the app; continues from it while running.

emptyState.summary: Content shown when there is no data or no items; each component has a default message.

error.summary: Loading failed: renders an error state, with Retry when `onRetry` is given.

errorMessage.summary: Error text shown while the control is invalid.
errorMessage.variance: `ReactNode or ((validation) => ReactNode)` on most fields, Checkbox, Switch; `ReactNode` only on RangeSlider, Slider, calendars, Knob; `string` on Editor (the cell's error, already shown by the table).

events.summary: Events (deploys, incidents, news) marked on the chart's time axis.

exclusiveGroup.summary: Players in the same group pause each other; `null` opts out. AudioPlayer defaults to one shared group, video players to `null`.

feedback.summary: Answer-check feedback marking an option with a tone, icon and message.
feedback.variance: Single `OptionFeedback` on Checkbox, Radio; `Readonly<Record<string, OptionFeedback>>` keyed by item id on ReorderableList.

fields.summary: Rule fields that conditions can test.

file.variance: `File` on FileThumbnail; `PreviewFile` (File or remote file) on FilePreview.

files.summary: Files to show as previews or list items.
files.variance: `readonly File[]` on DropZone (overrides last dropped, with `hasPreviews`); `readonly PreviewFile[]` on FilePreviewList.

filterValues.summary: Current filter values keyed by column id.

filters.summary: The filters offered to the user.
filters.variance: `readonly NotificationFilter[]` (id and label tabs such as All, Mentions) on NotificationBell, NotificationCenter; `readonly FilterConfig[]` filter-control definitions on TableToolbar, FilterPanel.

fit.summary: How an image initially fits its frame (`ImageFit`). Defaults to `fit`.

footer.summary: Footer content: actions in dialogs, extra content in cards and shells.
footer.variance: `DialogContent` (function receives `close`) on Dialog, Drawer; `ReactNode` on Card, CollapsibleCard, StatTile, AppShell, Sidebar.

foreground.summary: Colour of bars or dark modules in a rendered code. Defaults to black.

format.summary: Display format for the component's value.
format.variance: Timer: `'clock' or 'words'` display style. ModelViewer: source file format. Barcode: barcode symbology. RichTextEditor: document storage format (Markdown, HTML, Lexical JSON).

formatOptions.summary: `Intl` formatting options for the displayed value.
formatOptions.variance: `Intl.NumberFormatOptions` on most (PriceTicker, Sparkline, ScheduleEditor, TierEditor, Knob, SegmentedMeter, NumberCell, Gauge, MeterBar, BulletChart, ReferenceValue, Rating, RatingDisplay); `Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions` on RelativeTime.

formatValue.summary: Function that formats a value as display text.
formatValue.variance: `(value: number) => string` on ScheduleEditor, TierEditor; generic `(value: V) => string` on SchedulePreview.

gap.summary: Spacing between children (`Space` token). Grid and Stack default to `md`, Inline to `sm`.

getRowId.summary: Returns a stable id for each row so selection and state survive sorting and edits.

getRowLabel.summary: Returns a short row name for control labels and messages.
getRowLabel.variance: `(row) => string` (defaults to row header value) on DataTable; `(row, index) => string` (defaults to Row N) on EditableTable.

granularity.summary: The smallest unit of time shown. Defaults to `minute`.
granularity.variance: `'hour' | 'minute' | 'second'` on DateTimePicker; `'minute' | 'second'` on WorldClock, where `second` also makes the clocks tick every second.

grouping.summary: Price grouping (tick aggregation) such as 0.01, controlled. Ungrouped when missing.

handleRef.summary: Ref that receives the component's imperative handle.
handleRef.variance: Handle type per component: `LiveTimeSeriesHandle` (append points), `CandlestickChartHandle` (update latest candle), `AudioMeterHandle` (push, resetClip), `TerminalHandle` (write, clear, focus).

hasCharacterCount.summary: Shows a character counter under the field; needs `maxLength` (or `recommendedLength` where supported).

hasControls.summary: Shows the built-in zoom (and view) controls toolbar. Defaults to true.

hasDownload.summary: Shows a download button for the current item.

hasFullScreen.summary: Shows the full-screen button. Defaults to true.

hasGrid.summary: Draws a grid (floor or tick lines) behind the content.

hasMore.summary: Whether there are more items to load.

hasPreviews.summary: Shows thumbnails of files: the image for images, a kind icon otherwise.

hasRangeInfo.summary: Shows the CIDR range and address count. Defaults to true.

hasSearch.summary: Shows in-content text search. Defaults to true.

hasSummary.summary: Shows a plain-language rule summary. Defaults to true.

hasSummaryStep.summary: Adds a final review step summarizing all steps before confirming.

hasTableToggle.summary: Offers a View as table toggle. Defaults to true (CoordinatePlane only when there are functions).

hasThumbnails.summary: Shows a thumbnail strip or sidebar for navigating images or pages. Defaults to true.

hasToolbar.summary: Shows the component's toolbar. Defaults to true.

header.summary: Header content slot rendered above the main content.

headerControls.summary: Calendar header style: `cyclers` (default) month and year Cyclers, or `arrows` previous and next buttons.

headingLevel.summary: Heading level for the component's title or section headings; usually defaults to 3.
headingLevel.variance: `HeadingLevel` everywhere except PlanReview, which uses `Exclude<HeadingLevel, 6>` (child headings go one level below).

height.summary: Component height, usually a CSS length string; plots and viewers often switch to an aspect box on phones.
height.variance: CSS `string` on most (charts, viewers, Canvas, Map, Terminal). `number` px on Sparkline. `number or string` on Skeleton, Barcode. CanvasItem: `number` in canvas world units.

hiddenColumns.summary: Set of column ids to hide; controlled, changed by the TableToolbar column menu.

highlight.summary: Custom CodeHighlighter replacing the built-in syntax highlighter.

href.summary: URL the component (or its title/brand) links to; on Button it switches to link rendering (`never` on the button branch of the union).

icon.summary: Icon component (such as lucide-react) shown in the component; some default to a built-in icon.
icon.variance: `IconComponent` everywhere except Banner, which takes `IconComponent or null` (`null` hides the tone's default icon).

id.summary: Identifier for the component, either a logical key or the DOM id.
id.variance: Logical key: Tab and TabPanel (`Key`, pairs a tab with its panel and drives `selectedKey`), CanvasItem (`string`, the item's key in the canvas selection). DOM element id: Knob and Rating (the input's id) and MathFormula (the root's id, for in-page links).

initialScroll.summary: Where a sideways-scrolling plot starts, `start` or `end`; HeatmapChart defaults to `start`, CalendarHeatmap to `end`.

inputRef.summary: Ref to the component's underlying text entry element.
inputRef.variance: `Ref<HTMLInputElement>` on TextField, NumberField, SearchField, SlugField, CidrField and the unit/money fields; `Ref<HTMLTextAreaElement>` on TextArea, MarkdownEditor.

isActive.summary: Predicate deciding which nav item is current, overriding path matching.
isActive.variance: `(item: BottomTabItem) => boolean` on BottomTabBar; `IsActive` = `(item: NavItem) => boolean` on Sidebar.

isClearable.summary: Lets the user clear the value back to none. Defaults to false.
isClearable.variance: A clear button shows while there is a value on Select and the other fields (Select's onChange may then receive null). Rating has no button: choosing the current value again, or Delete or Backspace, clears it.

isCompact.summary: Switches to a denser presentation: Pagination hides page numbers and size choice, PropertyInspector puts labels beside inputs, Brand shows only the mark.

isDisabled.summary: Disables the component's interaction (ContextMenuTrigger leaves the native menu; Chip disables only its remove button).

isDismissable.summary: Lets the user dismiss the overlay or banner: Dialog/Drawer via Escape, backdrop or swipe (default true); Banner via a dismiss button.

isEditable.summary: Turns on drag editing (moving, resizing, creating or connecting items) with keyboard alternatives. Defaults to false.

isFullWidth.summary: Lets text lines run the full width instead of a readable measure of about 70 characters.

isIconOnly.summary: Shows only the icon, keeping the label as the accessible name.

isInvalid.summary: Marks the field invalid and shows `errorMessage`; editors with their own checks show both.

isLive.summary: Treats the media as a live stream (DVR seek window, Go live); players detect it when possible.

isLoading.summary: Shows a loading placeholder or skeleton instead of content; Skeleton defaults to true.

isLoadingMore.summary: More items are being fetched: the Load more button shows a spinner and further requests are held off.

isLoadingOlder.summary: Older entries are loading at the top; shows it and holds off further `onLoadOlder` calls.

isLooping.summary: Whether reaching the end goes back to the start: playback loops (MusicTransport), and arrow navigation wraps from the last option to the first (Cycler, default true).

isMuted.summary: Controlled muted state of the media. Defaults to false.

isOpen.summary: Controlled open (shown) state of the overlay, menu, drawer or banner; pair with `onOpenChange`.

isPaused.summary: Controlled pause state (timer keeps elapsed time; live chart stops advancing).

isPending.summary: Shows a spinner, keeps the button width, sets aria-busy and blocks presses; `never` on link and icon button variants.

isReadOnly.summary: Shows the value but prevents changes; LineItemsEditor switches to a plain printable invoice table.

isReorderable.summary: Allows the user to reorder items (drag in Tree, ListView, TagField and TransferList's chosen list; move actions in EditableTable); the app applies the move.

isTitleHidden.summary: Keeps the title for screen readers only, when the surrounding card already shows it.

isValueHidden.summary: Hides the formatted value text shown next to the label or dial (still announced).

isWrapping.summary: Lets a row wrap onto more lines (default false).

isZoomable.summary: Allows zooming the chart (pinch/pan on touch, Ctrl+wheel, drag where supported). Defaults to true.

items.summary: The collection of items the component renders.
items.variance: `Iterable<T>` on Select, ComboBox, MultiSelect; `readonly X[]` of a component-specific item type (DescriptionItem, BreadcrumbItem, TreeNode, NavItem, LineItem, etc.) on the others.

kind.summary: Selects which kind of thing the component represents.
kind.variance: `'exchange' or 'binary'` trade kind on TradeTicket; `FileKind` file category on FileKindIcon.

label.summary: Visible or accessible name of the component; required text for status indicators.
label.variance: `ReactNode` on fields, MenuButton, StatTile etc.; `string` on Spinner, Stepper, meters, tickers, CopyButton. Divergent: MathFormula uses it for an equation number like (3); CandlestickChart names the price series, not the chart; TableToolbar gives the row noun for the summary; CopyButton names what is copied (Copy label).

language.summary: CodeLanguage for syntax colouring. Defaults to `text` (no colours).

layout.summary: Chooses how the component arranges its parts; each component has its own layout union.
layout.variance: ButtonGroupLayout on ButtonGroup; `'list' or 'choice'` on MenuSection; DiffLayoutMode on DiffViewer; `'layered' or 'top-down' or 'manual'` on NodeGraph; MarkdownEditorLayout on MarkdownEditor; `'full' or 'compact'` on MediaTransport; `'grid' or 'carousel'` on ImageGallery.

levels.summary: Level values, with unrelated meanings per component.
levels.variance: LogViewer: `readonly LogLevel[]`, controlled filter of visible log levels. AudioMeter: `readonly number[]`, measured dBFS per channel (data). HierarchyPicker: `readonly HierarchyLevel[]`, names of hierarchy columns.

links.variance: SankeyChart: `readonly SankeyLink[]`, flow edges between nodes. Footer: `readonly FooterLink[]`, navigation hyperlinks.

loadDelay.summary: Debounce before `loadItems` runs, in milliseconds; defaults 300 (ComboBox, MultiSelect) or 200 (CommandPalette).

loadEmojiData.summary: EmojiDataLoader for the emoji data (the picker list and emoji names); defaults to emojibase English compact data.

loadItems.summary: Async loader for items matching the typed query; debounced, with an AbortSignal for stale queries.
loadItems.variance: Returns `Promise<Iterable<T>>` and replaces `items` on ComboBox, MultiSelect; returns `Promise<readonly CommandItem[]>` merged after the matching static items on CommandPalette.

loadMentions.summary: Async loader of mention suggestions after @ for a query, aborted when the query changes.
loadMentions.variance: Composer resolves `readonly ChatMention[]`; RichTextEditor uses EditorMentionLoader resolving `readonly EditorMentionOption[]` (same shape, different named types).

loadSource.summary: MediaSourceLoader that plays formats the library does not, such as DASH via dash.js.

markers.summary: Points marked on the component, each component with its own marker type.
markers.variance: SegmentedMeter: limit marks (turn the bar to warning). Map: `MapMarker` places. AudioPlayer: `AudioMarker` (ms). MediaTransport, Waveform: `MediaMarker` timeline points such as chapters.

max.summary: How many items show before a +N overflow; AvatarGroup defaults to 4, TagsCell to 3.

maxHeight.summary: Maximum height as a CSS length before content scrolls inside; defaults vary (often 24rem or 32rem).

maxItems.summary: Maximum number of entries: list and row editors (CidrList, LineItemsEditor, KeyValueEditor, EditableTable) turn their add control off at this count, and TagField refuses further tags with a message.

maxRangeDays.summary: Longest selectable range in days, counting both ends; farther days become unavailable.

maxRows.summary: Most visible text lines before the field scrolls; the field grows up to it (TextArea 8, JsonEditor 30, TemplateEditor 10, Composer 8, MarkdownEditor 20).

maxValue.summary: Largest allowed or displayed value (scale maximum); unit fields use the base unit.
maxValue.variance: `number` on most (ScheduleEditor, TierEditor, Gauge, MeterBar, unit fields, Knob default 100, SegmentedMeter capacity, BulletChart); `string` decimal on MoneyField.

maxZoom.summary: Largest zoom as a scale factor (image pixels for image components); defaults to 8 (800%).

mediaRef.summary: Ref to the underlying media element, for apps that need it.

menuLabel.summary: Accessible name for the menu; defaults to the trigger's label (or Menu aria-label, then moreActions message).

messages.summary: Either UI string overrides or chat message data.
messages.variance: UIProvider: `Partial<Messages>`, overrides for library UI strings. MessageList: `readonly ChatMessage[]`, the chat messages, oldest first.

minHeight.summary: Minimum height of the editing area as a CSS length; RichTextEditor defaults to 10rem.

minItemWidth.summary: Minimum item width for an auto-fit column grid; as many columns as fit.

minRows.summary: Visible text lines when the field is empty or short (TextArea 3, JsonEditor 8, TemplateEditor 3, Composer 1, MarkdownEditor 8).

minTileWidth.summary: Minimum tile width as a CSS length; as many columns as fit.

minValue.summary: Smallest allowed or displayed value (scale minimum); unit fields use the base unit; default 0 on meters.

minZoom.summary: Smallest zoom as a scale factor; Canvas defaults to 0.1 (10%), ImageViewer never exceeds the fitted zoom.

minorUnits.summary: Digits after the decimal point; defaults to the currency's standard (JPY 0, USD 2, BHD 3).

mode.summary: Selects an operating mode; the values and their role vary per component.
mode.variance: Pagination family: static `cursor`/`offset` union discriminator. OutcomeChart: render style `lines`/`stacked`. MathInput: entry restriction level. ConfigForm, CardForm, PageForm: `FormMode` controlled view/edit state with `defaultMode`, i.e. user-changeable state rather than config.

name.summary: Either the form field name for submission or a displayed name.
name.variance: Form submission name: JsonEditor, TemplateEditor, unit fields, MoneyField, Knob, Rating, RichTextEditor. Displayed entity name: FileThumbnail (file name), Avatar (person name, initials, colour), Brand (product name), UserMenu (signed-in user).

newRow.summary: Factory making a new row for add/insert; without it rows cannot be added.
newRow.variance: `() => Row` on EditableTable; `() => SpreadsheetRow` on Spreadsheet.

nodes.variance: `readonly SankeyNode[]` on SankeyChart; `readonly GraphNode[]` on NodeGraph.

now.summary: The current instant (Date or ms), instead of the shared clock or mount time, for tests, stories and replays.

onAction.summary: Called when an item is chosen or activated.
onAction.variance: `(key: Key)` with the item id on SettingsMenu, MenuButton, OverflowMenu, SplitButton, UserMenu, Toolbar, ActionBar; `(id: string)` on TileGrid and ListView (a row's activation); `()` on CanvasItem (Enter or double-click).

onAudition.summary: Asks the app to play a sound for a note or row being created, selected or pressed.
onAudition.variance: `(pitch, velocity)` on NoteTable, PianoRoll; `(rowId: string)` on StepSequencer.

onCancel.summary: Called when the user cancels; PageForm shows a Cancel button when set.

onChange.summary: Called with the component's new value after a user change.
onChange.variance: Each component delivers its own value type: `boolean` on Checkbox, Switch; `number or null` on NumberField and unit fields; `string or null` on MoneyField; arrays on list editors; `(id, value)` on PropertyInspector; `(value, option)` on TilePicker, FlagPicker; a method on Editor.

onChangeEnd.summary: Called once when a drag, key press or other adjustment ends.
onChangeEnd.variance: `(value: [number, number])` on RangeSlider; `(value: number)` on Slider, Knob.

onConfirm.summary: Called on confirm; a returned promise shows a pending state and a rejection shows its message inline.

onCopyError.summary: Called with the error when the clipboard refuses the copy.

onDayPress.summary: Called with the pressed day's ISO date string.

onDelete.summary: Called with the ids of items to delete.
onDelete.variance: `(ids) => void` on Canvas (Delete or Backspace key); `(ids) => Promise<void>` on AssetPicker, MediaLibrary (after confirmation, also enables multi-select).

onEventPress.summary: Called with the ChartEvent whose marker (or clustered popover entry) is pressed.

onExpandedChange.summary: Called with the new set of expanded row or node ids.

onIndexChange.summary: Called with the index of the current item as it changes: Lightbox's image, Carousel's first slide in view.

onLoadMore.summary: Asks for more items, from a Load more button or when the list end scrolls into view.

onLoadOlder.summary: Called when scrolled to the top to load and prepend older entries, keeping the scroll position.

onMove.summary: Called when the user moves an item, with the move to apply.
onMove.variance: `(move: TreeMove)` after a drop on Tree (new parent and position); `(move: ListMove)` after a drop or keyboard move on ListView (ids, target and position); `(position: CanvasPoint)` on CanvasItem, called continuously while dragging and at drag or nudge end.

onMutedChange.summary: Called with the new muted state from the mute toggle; MediaTransport shows the toggle only when set.

onOpenChange.summary: Called with the new open state when the overlay, menu or banner opens or closes.

onPlayingChange.summary: Called with the requested playing state from the play/pause button (and keys where supported).

onPress.summary: Called when the primary area is pressed (SplitButton's primary action; FilePreview instead of opening the viewer).

onPrevious.summary: Called by the Previous button; MediaTransport shows previous/next buttons only when set.

onRangeSelect.summary: Called with the start and end Dates of a range dragged across or zoomed to on a time chart.

onRemove.summary: Shows a remove button that calls this.
onRemove.variance: `() => void` on Chip; `(index: number) => void` per file on FilePreviewList.

onRepeat.summary: Press-and-hold repeat callback, fired at press start and repeatedly while held; `never` on IconButtonToggle.

onRetry.summary: Retries a failed operation; shows a Retry control where applicable.
onRetry.variance: `() => void` on ErrorState, charts and DataTable (retry loading); `(messageId: string) => void` on MessageList (resend a failed message).

onSeek.summary: Called with the time in seconds the user seeks to.

onSelect.summary: Called with the item the user chooses (emoji, assets or scope path).
onSelect.variance: `(emoji: string)` on EmojiPicker, EmojiPickerButton; `(assets: MediaAsset[])` on MediaLibrary; `(path: HierarchyPath)` on HierarchyPicker.

onSelectionChange.summary: Called when the selection changes, with the selected id(s).
onSelectionChange.variance: `(id, node)` on Tree; `(ids: string[])` on Canvas; `(id: string or null)` on NodeGraph, Map, ImageAnnotator; `(keys: Set<string>)` on DataTable, ListView.

onSubmit.summary: Submits the component's content; a returned promise shows pending state and a rejection shows an error.
onSubmit.variance: Composer passes `(message: ChatSubmission)` and may return void; TradeTicket takes `()` and must return `Promise<void>`.

onZoomChange.summary: Called with the new zoom whenever it changes.
onZoomChange.variance: `number` (1 = 100%) on ImageViewer; `PdfZoom` (`'fit-width'` or `'fit-page'` or number) on PdfViewer.

options.variance: `readonly PillboxOption<T>[]` (optionally with icons) on Pillbox; `readonly CyclerOption<T>[]` on Cycler.

orientation.summary: Layout axis of the component; default varies by component.
orientation.variance: `'horizontal' or 'vertical'` on most; CategoryChart, CategoryWaterfall add `'auto'` (default). Defaults differ: vertical on CheckboxGroup, RadioGroup, BoxPlotChart, AudioMeter; horizontal on Stepper, Slider, RangeSlider, SplitView, PianoKeyboard.

overlay.summary: ReactNode content drawn over the main surface, such as a legend or status chip.

overlays.summary: App-supplied content drawn over the main picture.
overlays.variance: `readonly TimeSeries[]` (indicator lines over prices) on CandlestickChart; `DicomOverlays` (corner text lists) on DicomViewer.

pitchRange.summary: MIDI pitches shown, both ends included (PianoKeyboard defaults to C3-C5, PianoRoll to C2-C6).

placeholder.summary: Text shown while the field or trigger is empty or nothing is chosen.

placement.variance: `AriaTooltipProps['placement']` (default `top`) on Tooltip; `ToastPlacement` (default `bottom-end`, phones always bottom) on ToastRegion.

playbackRates.summary: Speeds offered in the speed menu, e.g. [0.75, 1, 1.25, 1.5, 2].

playhead.summary: The current playback position to highlight.
playhead.variance: MusicNotation takes `{ measure, beat } or null` (both 1-based); PianoRoll takes a `number` of beats from the start.

prefix.summary: Content shown before the input, such as a currency code or URL base.

presentation.summary: How the file is presented: thumbnail card, inline viewer or dialog chip. Defaults to thumbnail.
presentation.variance: `'thumbnail' or 'inline' or 'dialog'` on FilePreview; `'thumbnail' or 'dialog'` on FilePreviewList.

presets.summary: Ready-made choices listed for quick selection, with component defaults.
presets.variance: `readonly TimeRangePreset[]` on TimeRangePicker; `readonly DicomWindowPreset[]` (window/level in modality units) on DicomViewer.

priceFormat.summary: `price` for exchanges or `probability` to show 0-1 prices as percentages. Defaults to `price`.

primaryAction.summary: The page's main action node, usually a solid Button; stays visible or sticky on phones.

quietZone.summary: Light margin around the code, in modules; defaults to the symbology's minimum (QR: 4).

recent.summary: Recently used items, persisted by the app, shown first.
recent.variance: `readonly string[]` (emoji) on EmojiPicker, EmojiPickerButton, ReactionBar; `readonly HierarchyPath[]` on HierarchyPicker.

recommendedLength.summary: Soft character limit; past it the counter shows a warning tone but the field stays valid.

ref.summary: Ref to the component's root element.
ref.variance: DOM element type varies (HTMLDivElement, HTMLElement, HTMLButtonElement, HTMLAnchorElement, HTMLSpanElement, HTMLHeadingElement, HTMLUListElement). ConfigForm, DialogForm, CardForm, PageForm, WizardForm expose an imperative `ConfigFormHandle<V>` instead of a DOM node.

renderTile.summary: Custom renderer for a tile's content, given the option and its render state.

renderValue.summary: TilePicker: draws the chosen option read-only in the trigger; defaults to its label.
renderValue.variance: TilePicker uses it to display the chosen option `(option) => ReactNode`. ScheduleEditor and TierEditor use it (custom value mode) to render the editable input field for a row value `(props: RowValueFieldProps<V>) => ReactNode`; it is `never` in numeric mode.

repeatDelay.summary: Milliseconds before press-and-hold repeating starts. Defaults to 400.

repeatInterval.summary: Milliseconds between press-and-hold repeats. Defaults to 60.

rows.summary: The row records the grid, table or picker displays.
rows.variance: `TileRow<O>[]` on TileGrid, TilePicker; `FlagRow[]` on FlagPicker; `HeatmapAxisItem[]` (row labels only) on HeatmapChart; `StepSequencerRow[]` on StepSequencer; `Row[]` on DataTable, EditableTable; `SpreadsheetRow[]` on Spreadsheet; `Schedule<V>` on SchedulePreview.

scale.summary: Value-to-position or value-to-colour mapping, e.g. linear or log.
scale.variance: `'linear' or 'log'` mapping on Knob, LatencyChart; `HeatScale` colour scale on HeatmapChart, CalendarHeatmap. AudioMeter.scale is a measurement unit (`'dbfs' or 'lufs'`); PianoRoll.scale is a musical scale (`MusicScale` root and mode) for row highlighting.

search.summary: Controlled search text; matching rows are filtered or highlighted.

searchLabel.summary: Accessible name of the search field.

segments.summary: SegmentedMeter: stacked value portions of the bar, in order; remainder of maxValue shows as free.
segments.variance: SegmentedMeter uses `MeterSegment[]` as stacked value parts of a bar; CoordinatePlane uses `PlaneSegment[]` as geometric line segments (from/to points, optional arrowhead).

selectedId.summary: The selected item's id, controlled; null for none.

selectionMode.summary: Whether items can be selected singly, multiply or not at all.
selectionMode.variance: `'single' or 'multiple'` on Calendar, Canvas; literal `'multiple'` on MultipleCalendar and `'single'` on SingleCalendar; adds `'none'` on TileGrid, MediaLibrary, DataTable, ListView. Defaults differ: single on Calendar, multiple on Canvas, none on MediaLibrary, DataTable, ListView.

series.variance: Chart series types vary: `TimeSeries[]`, `LatencySeries[]`, `CategorySeries[]`, `ScatterSeries[]`, `BoxPlotSeries[]`, `HourlySeries or ScheduleSeries[]`; LiveTimeSeries omits `data`. DicomViewer.series is DICOM image series (stacks of images shown as switchable thumbnails), not plotted data.

shape.summary: The visual shape of the element.
shape.variance: `'text' or 'rect' or 'circle'` (placeholder shape, default `text`) on Skeleton; `AvatarShape` (`'circle' or 'square'`, default `circle`) on Avatar.

shortcut.summary: Keyboard shortcut associated with the item or palette.
shortcut.variance: MenuItem: a literal display hint ("⌘E"), not bound. CommandPalette: a `mod+k`-style key spec that registers a global listener (`null` disables). CommandPaletteTrigger: the same spec rendered as Kbd keys. Format and behaviour differ.

shouldFollowPlayhead.summary: Keeps the playhead scrolled into view as it moves. Defaults to true.

side.summary: Drawer: the edge it slides from (`start` or `end`, default `end`).
side.variance: Drawer uses `'start' or 'end'` for screen edge; TradeTicket uses `TradeSide` for the trade direction (buy or sell), controlled.

size.summary: Size token for the component, usually `sm`, `md` or `lg`; defaults mostly `md`.
size.variance: Token unions vary (ButtonSize, Size, DialogSize, BadgeSize, CalendarSize, AvatarSize, `'sm' or 'md'`, `'sm' or 'md' or 'lg'`). QRCode takes a `number` of CSS pixels (default 192). Dialog sizes cap width; SegmentedMeter is bar thickness; ProbabilityBar `sm` changes layout.

skinTone.summary: Skin tone applied to emoji that support them.

skipSeconds.summary: Seconds the skip buttons move; defaults to 15 (audio) or 10 (video).

source.summary: The input the component reads its content from.
source.variance: `string` (text the slug derives from) on SlugField; `MediaStream or AudioNode` on AudioMeter; `string or ArrayBuffer or Blob` (document URL or data) on PdfViewer.

sparkline.summary: Recent values drawn as a small faint trend behind or beside the value.

src.summary: URL of the media to show (image, model or stream).

startedAt.summary: When counting or the process started (a Date, epoch milliseconds or an ISO string); elapsed time is measured from it.

status.summary: The status to show for the item.
status.variance: `RolloutStatus` (drives rollout state) on RolloutProgress; `{ tone, label }` override on Gauge, MeterBar; `StreamStatus` on StreamPreview, StreamStatusChip; `ReactNode` slot beside the title on Page, PageHeader.

step.summary: Increment that values snap to (Knob default 1, 0 for none; Rating 1 or 0.5).

steps.summary: Definitions of the steps the component shows, in order.

suffix.summary: ReactNode content after the input, such as a unit.

thresholds.summary: Values at which the tone or status changes.
thresholds.variance: `TimerThresholds` on Timer; `UptimeThresholds` (default warn below 99.9, danger below 99) on UptimeBar; `readonly ChartThreshold[]` on TimeSeriesChart, LiveTimeSeries; `GaugeThresholds` on Gauge, MeterBar.

ticks.summary: Marks drawn on the track or arc at these values.
ticks.variance: `readonly SliderTick[]` (with optional labels) on Slider, RangeSlider; `readonly number[]` on Knob.

timeSignature.summary: Beats per bar and the beat's note value. Defaults to 4/4.

timeZone.summary: IANA time zone for displayed and entered times; defaults to UIProvider's timeZone or the browser's zone.

title.summary: The component's visible heading or accessible name.
title.variance: `ReactNode` on most (Dialog, Drawer, Card, EmptyState, Page, CodeBlock, forms...); `string` on charts, DepthChart, ModelViewer, NodeGraph, CoordinatePlane, PdfViewer, StreamPreview, VideoPlayer, Terminal (often an accessible name only).

toNumber.summary: Maps a custom row value to a number for shading and charts; without it shades are uniform.

tone.summary: Colour role of the component; default varies (usually `neutral`).
tone.variance: `Tone` on most; `ButtonTone` on Button; `'neutral' or 'danger'` on MenuItem, ConfirmDialog; `FeedbackTone` (default `info`) on Banner; `ProgressTone` (default `accent`) on ProgressBar; `TextTone` on Heading; Sparkline defaults to `accent`; Rating and RatingDisplay to `warning`; on ToggleButton it colours only the pressed state.

tools.summary: The tools offered in the toolbar, in order; defaults to all.
tools.variance: `readonly DicomTool[]` on DicomViewer; `readonly AnnotationKind[]` on ImageAnnotator.

type.summary: Which kind of rendering or input the component uses (chart kind, input type).
type.variance: Rendering kind on Sparkline, CategoryBarChart, CategoryChart, CategoryWaterfall, CategoryFunnel, CategoryRadar; HTML input type on TextField. FileThumbnail.type is the file's MIME type (data); StreamPreview and VideoPlayer type is the stream protocol (`auto`, HLS, DASH, progressive).

typing.summary: People currently typing, shown as a typing indicator.

unit.summary: The values' unit label, shown after numbers and included in announcements.
unit.variance: `string` on most; `ReactNode` on StatTile; `'ms' or 's' or 'µs'` (default `ms`, the unit the data is in) on LatencyChart; `ModelUnits` (`'mm' or 'cm' or 'm' or 'in'`, the physical length one model unit represents) on ModelViewer; `never` on ScheduleEditor, TierEditor in custom value mode.

uploadImage.summary: Uploads a pasted, dropped or chosen image file and resolves to its src (and alt); without it images are added by URL.

validate.summary: Custom validation returning an error (message or errors map), or nothing when valid.
validate.variance: `(value: number or null)` on NumberField; `(pair, all)` per row on KeyValueEditor; async `(slug, signal) => Promise` on SlugField; `(rows) => errors by row and column` on EditableTable, Spreadsheet.

value.summary: The component's current value, usually controlled.
value.variance: Each control uses its own value type (number, string, ids, dates, ranges, rules, files...). Display-only on StatTile, PriceTicker, Gauge, cells, ReferenceValue; content to copy or encode on CopyButton, CopyField, Barcode, QRCode. Radio.value is the option's own value, not the current selection.

valueAxis.summary: The value axis's range and title, such as { min: 0, max: 100 }.
valueAxis.variance: `ValueAxisOptions` on CategoryBarChart, CategoryWaterfall, BoxPlotChart; CategoryChart accepts a union; CategoryRadar uses it for the radial axis (title only read in summary, defaults to zero start).

values.summary: The values the component displays or edits.
values.variance: `PropertyValues` (selected objects) on PropertyInspector; `FilterValues` (controlled, with onChange) on FilterPanel; [row][column] matrix on HeatmapChart; ISO-date record on CalendarHeatmap; `ObservationValue[]` on Flowsheet, ObservationTrend.

variant.summary: Visual style or layout variant of the component; defaults vary.
variant.variance: Each component has its own union: ButtonVariant (default `solid`), IconButtonVariant (`ghost`), BadgeVariant (`soft`), TextVariant, StepperVariant, MenuButton, SplitButton fill styles, ToggleButtonVariant (`soft`, `outline`, `ghost`); layout variants on Timer, PriceTicker, Gauge, AudioPlayer.

view.summary: Which display mode the content is shown in.
view.variance: `'month' or 'week'` (default month) on Calendar, MultipleCalendar, SingleCalendar; `'grid' or 'list'` (controlled) on AssetPicker, MediaLibrary.

visibleMonths.summary: Months shown side by side (1 to 12), wrapping when space is short. Defaults to 1.

warnings.summary: Warnings shown to the user above the content.
warnings.variance: `readonly ReactNode[]` on PlanReview; `readonly string[]` on TradeTicket.

width.summary: Skeleton: width as a CSS length or pixels; defaults to full width.
width.variance: Skeleton takes a CSS length or px `number or string`. CanvasItem takes a `number` in canvas world units (defaults to the child's size). Page takes a max-width preset `'narrow' or 'medium' or 'full'` capping content width.

workerSrc.summary: URL of the pdf.js worker script used for PDF rendering.

workingDays.summary: The working days of the week (0 = Sunday). Defaults to Monday to Friday.

workingHours.summary: The hours of a working day (`GanttWorkingHours`, `start` to `end`, 0–24). GanttChart shades outside them (default 9 to 17); WorldClock shows whether each clock is within them, only when they're given.

yearRange.summary: The years the year Cycler offers, both included; defaults from minValue and maxValue.

zoom.summary: Zoom or scale factor of the content.
zoom.variance: `PdfZoom` (`'fit-width' or 'fit-page'` or number), controlled, on PdfViewer; `number` scale factor (default 1) on MusicNotation.

defaultIndex.summary: The index of the current item at first, uncontrolled: Lightbox's image, Carousel's first slide in view. Defaults to 0.

index.summary: The index of the current item, controlled: Lightbox's image, Carousel's first slide in view.

defaultSelectedKeys.summary: The chosen rows' ids at first, uncontrolled.

hasPicker.summary: Shows a control that jumps straight to any value: Cycler's grid of values, Carousel's dots or thumbnails. Defaults to true.

isPlaying.summary: Whether playback is running, controlled: the media on MediaTransport and MusicTransport, autoplay on Carousel.

shouldAutoPlay.summary: Starts playing by itself, with a control to stop it: a video once it loads (VideoPlayer, StreamPreview), slides moving on every `autoPlayIntervalMs` (Carousel).

isRequired.summary: Marks the field as required: the label shows it, and validation fails while the field is empty.

isSearchable.summary: Shows a search field that filters the options (over each list on TransferList). Defaults to true.

isVirtualized.summary: Renders only the rows in view, for long lists (thousands of rows). DataTable scrolls inside `maxHeight`; ListView does too with `maxHeight`, and follows the page's scroll without it.

onBlur.summary: Called when the field loses focus.
onBlur.variance: `() => void` on JsonEditor, TemplateEditor; Rating passes its range input's `FocusEvent`.

onRowAction.summary: Called with a `rowActions` menu item's key and its row.
onRowAction.variance: The row is DataTable's `Row` on DataTable and the `ListViewItem` on ListView.

renderActions.summary: Controls at the end of a row (for example an OverflowMenu), shown on hover, focus or selection, and always on touch.
renderActions.variance: Called with the `TreeNode` on Tree and the `ListViewItem` on ListView.

rowActions.summary: Menu items (`MenuItem`) for a row's actions menu, opened from a "more" button at the end of the row.
rowActions.variance: Called with DataTable's `Row` on DataTable and the `ListViewItem` on ListView.

sections.summary: Groups of items, each with an optional heading.
sections.variance: `NavSection[]` navigation groups on Sidebar; `ListViewSection[]` with sticky headings on ListView.

confirmPhrase.summary: Word or name the user must type before a destructive confirm is enabled.

expandedIds.summary: The ids of the expanded rows or nodes, controlled; see `defaultExpandedIds`.
expandedIds.variance: `Iterable<string>` on GanttChart, KanbanBoard, OrgChart, Tree; `ReadonlySet<string>` on DataTable (tree rows).

updatedAt.summary: When the value or statuses were last updated.
updatedAt.variance: `Date | number | string` (Date, epoch ms or ISO string) on PriceTicker, StatusBar; `Date` on WidgetFrame.

defaultSelectedTab.variance: `string` tab id on Page, PageHeader; `'write' | 'preview'` on MarkdownEditor (tabs layout, default `write`).

descriptions.after: The new text; the right-hand side of the diff.
descriptions.bands: Shaded value ranges drawn behind the series, such as a normal operating band, each with optional label, axis and tone.
descriptions.before: The original text; the left-hand side of the diff.
descriptions.breadcrumbs: Trail of ancestor links shown above the page title.
descriptions.captions: Subtitle or caption tracks offered in the player's captions menu.
descriptions.changes: The planned changes to review, each with its kind and details.
descriptions.code: The source text to display and highlight.
descriptions.criticalRange: Optional low and high bounds beyond which the value is flagged critical.
descriptions.currentStageId: Id of the stage currently being rolled out; earlier stages show complete.
descriptions.defaultFilterValues: Filter values applied at first, keyed by column (uncontrolled).
descriptions.defaultHiddenColumns: Ids of columns hidden at first (uncontrolled).
descriptions.defaultMode: The form's initial mode (such as view or edit), uncontrolled.
descriptions.defaultRecentIds: Recently chosen item ids, newest first, shown at first (uncontrolled).
descriptions.defaultSecondaryOpen: Whether the secondary pane's drawer starts open on narrow containers (uncontrolled).
descriptions.defaultSelected: Not supported on action buttons; only toggle buttons take an initial selected state (typed never).
descriptions.defaultSelectedId: Id of the item selected at first (uncontrolled); null means none.
descriptions.defaultSelectedKeys: Keys of rows selected at first (uncontrolled).
descriptions.defaultSelectedTab: Id of the tab selected at first (uncontrolled).
descriptions.defaultSelection: Ids of the items selected at first (uncontrolled).
descriptions.defaultSort: The sort applied at first, column and direction (uncontrolled); null means unsorted.
descriptions.defaultSorting: Sort columns in priority order applied at first (uncontrolled).
descriptions.delta: Change versus a previous period, shown beside the value with its direction and tone.
descriptions.edges: The connections between nodes, each naming its source and target node ids.
descriptions.falseLabel: Text shown when the value is false.
descriptions.field: The form field's API: its value, state, and handlers for the custom renderer to use.
descriptions.functions: Mathematical functions to plot, each a function of x.
descriptions.hasNext: Whether a next page exists; enables the Next button.
descriptions.hasPrevious: Whether a previous page exists; enables the Previous button.
descriptions.image: The image to show, with its source, dimensions and alt text.
descriptions.images: The list of images to show, each with its source and alt text.
descriptions.isMinorUnits: Treats the value as minor currency units (cents) and divides accordingly before formatting.
descriptions.isPlaying: Whether playback is running; shows the pause button when true, play otherwise.
descriptions.isRequired: Marks the field as required for the user and for form validation.
descriptions.isSelected: Not supported on action buttons; only toggle buttons take a selected state (typed never).
descriptions.isTrue: The boolean to display; null or undefined shows an empty cell.
descriptions.justify: Main-axis distribution of children: start, center, end or between.
descriptions.lanes: The rows (resources or people) that timeline items are placed in.
descriptions.maxLength: Maximum number of characters the message may contain.
descriptions.notes: The notes to show, each with pitch, start time and duration.
descriptions.observation: The measure being tracked (a vital sign, lab test or sensor), with its unit and ranges.
descriptions.observations: The measures to list as rows, such as vital signs or lab tests.
descriptions.onAnnouncingErrorsChange: Called with whether new error lines are announced to screen readers, when toggled.
descriptions.onAudioStreamChange: Called with the id of the stream whose audio plays, or null when muted.
descriptions.onBlur: Called when the editor loses focus.
descriptions.onContextMenu: Handler for the right-click event, which opens the context menu.
descriptions.onCopy: Called after the value is copied to the clipboard.
descriptions.onEnded: Called when the track finishes playing.
descriptions.onFilterChange: Called with the id of the filter the user selects.
descriptions.onFilterValuesChange: Called with the full set of filter values whenever a filter changes.
descriptions.onFocusedStreamChange: Called with the id of the focused stream, or null when focus is cleared.
descriptions.onFollowingChange: Called with whether the log is following (auto-scrolling to) new lines.
descriptions.onHiddenColumnsChange: Called with the set of hidden column ids when columns are shown or hidden.
descriptions.onInputModeChange: Called with the order-entry mode, amount or quantity, when it is switched.
descriptions.onKeyDown: Handler for key presses, which opens the context menu from the keyboard.
descriptions.onLevelsChange: Called with the visible log levels when the level filter changes.
descriptions.onModeChange: Called with the new form mode when it switches, such as view to edit.
descriptions.onNavOpenChange: Called with whether the navigation drawer is open when it opens or closes.
descriptions.onNext: Called when the Next control is activated.
descriptions.onNoteOff: Called with the MIDI pitch when a key is released.
descriptions.onNoteOn: Called with the MIDI pitch and velocity when a key is pressed.
descriptions.onOrderTypeChange: Called with the new order type when the user changes it.
descriptions.onOverlayHiddenChange: Called with whether the overlay text is hidden, when toggled.
descriptions.onPageSizeChange: Called with the chosen number of rows per page.
descriptions.onPausedChange: Called with whether the live chart is paused, when toggled.
descriptions.onPlaybackRateChange: Called with the chosen playback speed multiplier, such as 1.5.
descriptions.onPointerCancel: Pointer-cancel handler, used to cancel the long-press that opens the menu on touch.
descriptions.onPointerDown: Pointer-down handler, used to start the long-press that opens the menu on touch.
descriptions.onPointerMove: Pointer-move handler, used to cancel the long-press if the pointer moves away.
descriptions.onPointerUp: Pointer-up handler, used to cancel the long-press when the pointer is released.
descriptions.onPointMove: Called with the point's id and its new x and y plane coordinates while dragged.
descriptions.onRangeChange: Called with the new visible time range when the user navigates or zooms.
descriptions.onReply: Called with the id of the message the user chose to reply to.
descriptions.onRowAction: Called with the chosen menu item's key and the row it was chosen for.
descriptions.onSearchChange: Called with the new search text as it changes.
descriptions.onSeriesChange: Called with the id of the series the user switches to.
descriptions.onSideChange: Called with the new trade side, such as buy or sell, when it changes.
descriptions.onSkinToneChange: Called with the emoji skin tone the user picks.
descriptions.onSliceChange: Called with the 0-based slice index when the shown slice changes.
descriptions.onSnapChange: Called with the new note snap grid value, such as 1/16, when changed.
descriptions.onSortChange: Called with the new column sort, or null when sorting is cleared.
descriptions.onSortingChange: Called with the sort columns in priority order when sorting changes.
descriptions.onStepChange: Called with the 0-based step number when the user moves between steps.
descriptions.onSuccess: Called with the submitted values and result after a successful submit.
descriptions.onTabChange: Called with the id of the tab the user selects.
descriptions.onToggleChange: Called with the node id, toggle id and new on/off value when a node toggle is switched.
descriptions.onToolChange: Called with the pointer tool the user selects.
descriptions.onViewChange: Called with grid or list when the user switches the layout.
descriptions.onViewportChange: Called with the new viewport (pan offset and zoom) as it changes.
descriptions.onVolumeChange: Called with the new volume, from 0 to 1, when the slider moves.
descriptions.onWrappedChange: Called with whether long lines wrap, when the wrap toggle changes.
descriptions.outcomes: The outcomes to chart, each with a name and probability over time.
descriptions.pageSize: Number of items shown per page.
descriptions.pagination: Paging state for the table: current page, page size and total, or server paging callbacks.
descriptions.playbackRate: Current playback speed multiplier, where 1 is normal speed.
descriptions.polygons: Filled shapes to draw, each defined by a list of plane points.
descriptions.poster: URL of the image shown before playback starts.
descriptions.properties: The properties to list and edit, each with a key, label, type and value.
descriptions.reactions: The emoji reactions on the message, each with its emoji, count and whether the current user reacted.
descriptions.referenceRange: The normal low and high bounds; values outside are flagged out of range.
descriptions.row: The data of the row being edited.
descriptions.secondaryActions: Lower-emphasis page actions shown beside the primary action, each with a label and handler.
descriptions.selectedKeys: Keys of the selected rows, controlled.
descriptions.selectedTab: Id of the selected tab, controlled.
descriptions.stages: The ordered rollout stages, such as canary, 25% and 100%.
descriptions.streams: The video streams shown in the grid, each with an id, source and title.
descriptions.subtitle: Secondary text shown beneath the title.
descriptions.tags: The tags to show as chips in the cell.
descriptions.targets: The destinations being rolled out to, such as regions or clusters, each with its status.
descriptions.taxRates: The tax rates a line can select, each with an id, label and percent.
descriptions.track: The track to play, with its source, title and artist.
descriptions.trueLabel: Text shown when the value is true.
descriptions.xRange: Visible horizontal range as [min, max] in plane units.
descriptions.y: Vertical world position of the item's top-left corner.
descriptions.yRange: Visible vertical range as [min, max] in plane units.
